WITH tx AS (
  SELECT s.transref AS transref, t.ordertypedist AS mix, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS avg_si, AVG(s.optvolrt) AS avg_ov
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref
  GROUP BY s.transref, t.ordertypedist
),
base AS (
  SELECT t.ordertypedist AS mix, AVG(s.shortintrt) AS base_si
  FROM sentimentandfundamentals s
  JOIN transactionrecord t ON t.transreg = s.transref
  GROUP BY t.ordertypedist
)
SELECT tx.transref, tx.mix AS ordertypedist, tx.avg_si, tx.avg_ov,
  CASE WHEN base.base_si IS NULL OR base.base_si = 0 THEN NULL ELSE tx.avg_si / base.base_si END AS ratio
FROM tx
LEFT JOIN base ON base.mix IS tx.mix
ORDER BY (ratio IS NULL), ratio DESC
LIMIT 10
